predictions.prediction_text: Heatmap shows a sticky/suppressive zone between ~5995 and ~6055 created by customer long iron-condor (5995/6000 put spread and 6050/6055 call spread). This range is a potential pin area (5995 acting as downside pin) with mean-reversion bias back toward the upper edge (~6055).
predictions.condition: price remains between 5995 and 6055 without vol bid/offer
predictions.expected_result: Expect intraday reversion rallies toward ~6055; downside should be capped near 5995 (limited follow-through) unless substantial vol bidding appears to break below 5995.

predictions.prediction_text: Gamma peak / trough lines cluster near ~6055 (gamma trough) and ~5995 (gamma peak), indicating these levels will act as short-speed boundaries and likely rejection/pinning levels intraday.
predictions.condition: no change in gamma profile (no large trade flows)
predictions.expected_result: Price should oscillate within the 5995–6055 corridor with increased rejection at ~5995 on down-moves and resistance around ~6055 on up-moves; breakouts require clear vol bid (below) or vol offer (above).
